summary: Verified deployment health probe fix and existing /api routes. Backend /health (no /api prefix) returns 200 with {"status":"healthy"} on localhost:8001 (which is what Kubernetes probes hit directly on the backend pod). /api/, /api/status GET/POST, and CORS all pass. Externally, ingress routes non-/api paths to the frontend (returns index.html 200), which is expected and does not affect the K8s liveness/readiness probe.
critical_code_review_comments: CORSMiddleware is added AFTER app.include_router. FastAPI middleware should generally be added before including routes; while it still works because middleware is applied at request time, prefer adding CORSMiddleware near app creation for clarity.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in modern FastAPI; consider migrating to lifespan handlers.
seed_data_creation: One /api/status row created with client_name='deploy_test' during POST test (safe test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Deployment health probe fix verified. Backend /health at localhost:8001 returns JSON 200. External /health via ingress returns frontend HTML (200) — this is fine because K8s probes hit the backend pod directly, not through ingress. All /api endpoints functional.
rca of the issue: Original 404 on /health was because backend only exposed routes under /api. Fix added a top-level @app.get('/health') returning {'status':'healthy'} — confirmed working on backend port 8001.
